personas.judgment: Within one LAN, a novice can probably finish with the guided path if the family Mac was set up by someone in person and they know its short account name (the only in-product way to learn it is `whoami` in Terminal, or Itda installed on that Mac). Reaching a family Mac in another home needs Tailscale on both machines plus account sign-in, which this persona is unlikely to manage alone. Error copy is a strength.

macOS Local Network prompt: what happens after Allow and after Don't Allow (Nearby empty? connect = unreachable?)

Permission helper with real TCC (screen recording/accessibility restart flow); only the mocked e2e passed
Remote family case over Tailscale end to end

source: gateway cookie HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; 12h TTL; same-origin check on POST/WS; per-source 5-fail/1-min lockout plus a global 50-fail lock (src/gateway.rs:33,412-479). Transport is plain HTTP on the LAN unless Tailscale HTTPS is used (documented in-app).
personas.judgment: With fixtures the browser flow is short and the PIN/session handling is sound. Comprehension and recovery are the weak spots: the first screen points to the wrong place, auth failures have no 'fix password' route, and controls are icon-only with tooltips that touch devices never show. Phone access also needs a computer running Itda on the same network and kept awake. The landing page shows phone visitors only Windows/Mac download buttons.
verification_gaps: Real iOS Safari and Android Chrome: QR camera hand-off, PIN keypad, add-to-home/PWA standalone
noVNC touch gestures on device (tap, two-finger tap right-click, two-finger scroll, pinch toggling fit)

Clipboard sheet copy on iOS (navigator.clipboard over plain HTTP falls back to select)
Behavior when PIN is reset or web viewer stopped while a phone is mid-session
Tailscale HTTPS address end to end

top_issues.title: Phone login screen points to a Windows-only, nonexistent location for the PIN
top_issues.evidence: web/viewer/index.html:22 'Windows PC의 Itda 설정 → ‘다른 기기에서 보기’'; actual UI is sidebar 공유 page on both Mac and Windows (web/app.js:357, 740, 763); same pattern web/viewer/viewer.js:493 ('PC의 Itda 설정에서 Tailscale HTTPS…') and :514 ('PC의 Itda에서…' for a Mac key change). Screenshot p01-login.png.
top_issues.fix: Neutral copy: '컴퓨터(Mac·PC)의 Itda → 왼쪽 공유 페이지에 표시된 6자리 PIN을 입력하세요'. Optionally let /api/me report the host platform and name ('김영희의 MacBook') so the copy can say exactly where. Apply the same wording to the install hint and 4021.

top_issues.title: Phone connection failures have no route to fix credentials; lockout gives no duration
top_issues.evidence: web/viewer/viewer.js:518-526 status card only offers 목록으로/다시 연결; retry re-sends the same saved bad password. 4010 advice for Mac is generic (viewer.js:508) while the desktop says 'Apple ID 아님' (web/app.js:1466-1470). Lockout message 'PIN을 여러 번 틀렸습니다' has no time (src/gateway.rs:440) though help says 1분. Session expiry/PIN reset drops to login silently (viewer.js:232). Screens p02, p05-4010, p07.
top_issues.fix: For 4010/4011/4020/4001 add a primary '암호·계정 고치기' that opens editHost(h) (account editor when h.account). Use the desktop Mac tips (짧은 이름, Apple ID 아님). Lockout: '1분 뒤 다시 시도하세요'. On 401 after an earlier sign-in, show '다시 로그인해 주세요 (PIN이 바뀌었거나 12시간이 지났습니다)'.

top_issues.title: No in-app recovery when macOS Local Network access is denied
top_issues.evidence: Only the bundle string (scripts/macos-bundle.sh:69) and docs/start.html mention the prompt; no in-app string mentions 로컬 네트워크 settings. Nearby empty state (web/app.js:627) and ERRORS.unreachable/timeout (web/app.js:1490-1500) suggest Wi-Fi/VPN/IP instead. A novice who taps 허용 안 함 is stuck. The OS behaviour is not natively verified; the copy gap is verified in source.
top_issues.fix: On Mac, add to the Nearby empty state and to unreachable/timeout tips: 'Itda가 로컬 네트워크를 쓰지 못하면 기기가 보이지 않습니다 → 시스템 설정 → 개인정보 보호 및 보안 → 로컬 네트워크에서 Itda 켜기', with a button opening x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_LocalNetwork. If the app can detect the denial (e.g. EHOSTUNREACH to a private address), surface it directly.

top_issues.title: Phone toolbar overflows 390px, icon-only, small targets; pinch zoom disabled
top_issues.evidence: web/viewer/viewer.css:145-159,209; measured toolbar scrollWidth 420/clientWidth 372, '전체 화면' at x 383–425; buttons 42×40; list refresh 36, edit 34, tabs 35 px; nopw card instruction truncated (viewer.css:55-58); web/viewer/index.html:5 user-scalable=no. Screens p03, p06.
top_issues.fix: 44×44 minimum; fold the less common controls (monitors, scale, viewonly, full) into a '더 보기' sheet with text labels, or wrap to two rows under 420px; show a one-time labelled legend on first connect; let .host .warn wrap (white-space: normal); drop user-scalable=no on login/list (keep touch-action on the canvas instead).

top_issues.title: Home modals lack dialog semantics, focus management and labelled fields
top_issues.evidence: web/app.js:953-966 openModal: no role=dialog/aria-modal/aria-labelledby, no focus trap, no focus return; onboarding welcome has no input/.btn.primary so focus stays on <body> and Tab reaches the sidebar behind the scrim (fixture). Labels without for= at web/app.js:1136,1147,1148 (also 1043,1447); reveal buttons tabindex=-1.
top_issues.fix: In openModal set role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby to the first h2; focus the first focusable control (or the dialog itself); trap Tab; restore focus on close. Add for=/id pairs; make the reveal button focusable with aria-label '암호 보기' and aria-pressed.

top_issues.title: '밖에서도 쓸 거라면 원격 로그인도 켜 두세요' implies Remote Login alone enables away-from-home use
top_issues.evidence: web/app.js:537 and docs/start.html:122; the same guide and help (web/help.js:450-456) say away-from-home needs Tailscale, or SSH port forwarding without it. Turning on Remote Login also exposes SSH.
top_issues.fix: Replace with: '집 밖에서 쓰려면 두 Mac에 Tailscale을 설치하세요 (자세히)'. Mention Remote Login only as an optional extra for encryption/high-performance mode, inside the Tailscale step.

top_issues.title: Landing page on a phone offers only Windows/Mac downloads
top_issues.evidence: docs/index.html hero at 390px: two full-width download CTAs; the phone path is only one sentence (s-phone-index.html.png).
top_issues.fix: When the UA is mobile, swap or add a CTA '휴대폰에서 쓰기 — 설치 없이' → start.html#phone, explaining that a Mac/PC running Itda on the same Wi-Fi is needed.

top_issues.title: The Mac short account name is a dead end for non-technical users
top_issues.evidence: Editor placeholder '예: alex' + hint '짧은 이름 (Apple ID 아님)'; the only lookup offered is `whoami` in Terminal (docs/start.html Mac section). The remote Mac's Itda share page shows it (web/app.js:776) only if Itda is installed there.
top_issues.fix: Add a helper link next to the field: '계정 이름 찾기' → picture of System Settings → 사용자 및 그룹 → (i) showing 계정 이름; mention that the family member can read it there.

notes: Strengths, each backed by evidence above: specific, device-aware error dialogs with direct actions on desktop; onboarding goes straight to Nearby/editor; PIN lockout and cookie flags are sound; permission helper e2e passes.
Score movement after fixes needs re-observation; per policy, natively unverified journeys stay pending.
